image_description: An open, soft-sided carpenter's tool roll or pouch lying flat on a white surface with blurred green foliage in the background. The kit contains various hand tools including screwdrivers with wooden handles, a utility knife, a small level, and other implements organized in fabric pockets. Several loose screwdrivers are placed in front of the kit.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The container is a flexible fabric roll/pouch, not a rigid rectangular box as specified in the taxonomy prior knowledge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular box with carrying handle silhouette.

The tools are arranged in an orderly, functional manner within the pockets.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Container made of plastic metal or canvas.

artifact_observations.location: Labels on tools inside the kit (green and yellow items)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the labels of the level and other tools is illegible gibberish, a common AI artifact where text simulation fails.

artifact_observations.location: Handles of the three screwdrivers in the foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wooden handles of the foreground screwdrivers appear to merge into each other and lack distinct separation at the base; the metal shafts also show slight warping and inconsistent thickness.

artifact_observations.location: Fabric edges of the tool roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring and softness at the edges of the fabric pockets where they meet the white background, suggesting minor segmentation or generation bleed.

To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and texture quality of the tools and fabric.
To rigorously check the boundaries between the three adjacent screwdriver handles for fusion or bleeding artifacts.
To confirm the illegibility of the text on the tool labels and quantify the text generation failure.

Legibility and realism of text on tool labels
